connectorUiConfig.title: Dynatrace Problems V3
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: This connector uses the [Dynatrace DQL Storage Query API](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/platform/grail/dynatrace-query-language) to ingest Davis AI problem events into Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics.
connectorUiConfig.additionalRequirementBanner: This data connector depends on a parser based on Kusto Function to work as expected which is deployed with the Microsoft Sentinel Solution.

sampleQueries.query:
DynatraceProblems
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceProblems
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ProblemId
| where Status == "OPEN"
| take 10

DynatraceProblems
| where SeverityLevel == "ERROR"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceProblems
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ProblemId
| summarize count() by ImpactLevel
| take 10

DynatraceProblemsV3_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by problem_id
| where maintenance_is_under_maintenance == true
| take 10

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Dynatrace SaaS environment (ex. xyz.apps.dynatrace.com)
customs.description: You need a Dynatrace SaaS environment (xxx.apps.dynatrace.com). Classic Dynatrace environments (xxx.live.dynatrace.com) are not supported.

customs.name: Dynatrace Platform Token
customs.description: You need a Dynatrace platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read*** and ***storage:events:read*** scopes. See [Dynatrace platform tokens](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens) for instructions.

instructionSteps.title: Dynatrace Problem Events to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
1. Create a platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read*** and ***storage:events:read*** scopes following [these instructions](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens). 
 2. Use your Dynatrace SaaS environment URL in the format ***xyz.apps.dynatrace.com***. Classic Dynatrace environments (***xxx.live.dynatrace.com***) are not supported.
